description: Caller expressing personal difficulty reducing alcohol consumption and feeling anxious about employment.

synthetic_dialogue.speaker: caller
synthetic_dialogue.text: Main pichle kuch mahino se bohot pareshan hoon. Sharaab chhodne ki koshish karta hoon lekin neend nahi aati aur kaam par dikkat hoti hai.

synthetic_dialogue.speaker: agent
synthetic_dialogue.text: Aapki pareshani samajh sakta hoon. Yeh bohot himmat ki baat hai ki aapne helpline par sampark kiya. Hamare tele-counselor aapko withdrawal management aur counseling ke baare me margdarshan denge.
